name: @lecturedoc2/quizzy
description: Embeddable <ld-quiz> web component for real-time quizzes in HTML presentations
author: Michael Eichberg (http://www.michael-eichberg.de/)
//: Source ESM, not a bundle: `ld-quiz.js` imports `@lecturedoc2/libcrypto` and (via `qr-canvas.js`) `qrcode-generator` by bare specifier, so a consumer needs a bundler (or an import map). Consumers that cannot build use the pre-bundled script the quiz server publishes at /component/<version>/ld-quiz.js -- see the README.
